name: First Digital USD

regulatory_status.framework: Trust or Company Service Provider (TCSP) Licence
regulatory_status.status: First Digital Trust Limited holds TCSP Licence No. TC006771 under the Hong Kong Companies Registry; stablecoin issuance itself is not separately licensed — the issuer states it is 'actively working to secure regulatory authorisation for its stablecoin issuance.'

description: A fiat-backed USD stablecoin issued by First Digital Trust Limited in Hong Kong. Note: in 2024, Tron founder Justin Sun publicly accused First Digital Trust of misappropriating reserves belonging to TrueUSD (a separate, unrelated token); FDUSD briefly depegged amid the controversy despite the dispute not concerning its own reserves, which were independently reattested afterward.
